reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Averius as a Litecoin-mining site, directs viewers to register, activate a miner, and transfer payment, and claims deposits can earn two or three percent daily. It also describes referral benefits and displays a mining balance and daily-profit figure, while noting possible affiliate commissions and advising viewers to research before investing.

citations.quote: Mine Free Litecoin with this new site | Earn Crypto
when you deposit you can end up to two percent or three percent daily profit of two percent per deposit
We also have an affiliate program on this site where you can refer friends and families on this site and earn amazing income.

opening.argument: Judge the daily-profit statement alongside the creator's qualifications, not in isolation. The description says results vary and expressly warns that the creator's experience does not predict a viewer's outcome. The speaker also tells viewers to research the site before investing. Those warnings do not prove the platform works, but they weaken the reading that the video promises everyone a certain return or conceals investment risk.

citations.quote: Individual results may vary. The fact that I have made money from these websites does not mean that you too can make the same amount of money.
Don't forget guys before you make an investment into this site, kindly do a detailed research on your own.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited daily-profit language is a reason for caution, but the opening treats a described deposit feature as though it establishes a certain payout or a deliberately concealed risk. The same presentation explicitly asks viewers to conduct their own research before investing. A referral feature likewise establishes an incentive, not that viewers were told returns were assured.

citations.quote: Don't forget guys before you make an investment into this site, kindly do a detailed research on your own.
We also have an affiliate program on this site where you can refer friends and families on this site and earn amazing income.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The warnings qualify outcomes, but they do not undo the solicitation. The speaker instructs viewers to copy a Litecoin deposit address and make a payment, then says they will make two percent of that deposit daily. Asking viewers to research the site does not turn that specific deposit-linked earnings claim into neutral risk education.

citations.quote: so you copy it and make your payment and the litecoin will be reflected to your account and you make a 2 percent of your deposit into this site daily
Don't forget guys before you make an investment into this site, kindly do a detailed research on your own.

opening.argument: Much of the presentation is a walkthrough of an interface: the speaker explains registration, sign-in and how to activate the displayed miner. Later, the speaker navigates withdrawal and deposit controls. Showing where those controls are is not evidence that a viewer has paid, earned a return or successfully withdrawn funds. The description calls the videos educational and says results may vary. The stronger reading is a demonstration of a service's workflow, with its claims left for viewers to assess.

citations.quote: choose your username and enter an email address choose your password confirm your password if you fire your capture click on register
so you just toggle your bar to your 100 percent to activate your miner instantly
I'll show you guys how to withdraw, how to deposit
All the videos on this channel are for educational purposes only. Individual results may vary.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening correctly identifies deposit and referral claims, but a walkthrough of those screens does not establish that money was deposited or a withdrawal completed. The speaker describes how to enter a withdrawal amount and wallet address; that is an instruction, not a demonstrated payout. The mining balance and referral display similarly show what the interface presents, not independently verified earnings.

citations.quote: Then input the amount of USDT you want to redraw. You input the amount of coins to redraw, Then click on redraw, Then you input the wallet address here

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a completed withdrawal does not make the walkthrough neutral. The speaker directs viewers to the video link and through registration, then gives payment instructions and links a deposit to daily profit. The demonstration supplies a path into the offer while promoting its claimed return; it is not merely an explanation of interface controls.

citations.quote: I want to click the link on the description of this video I'm going to bring you right to this page
so you copy it and make your payment and the litecoin will be reflected to your account and you make a 2 percent of your deposit into this site daily

opening.argument: The referral portion can be read as an ordinary promotion attached to a service. The speaker describes sharing a link with friends and family, and the description discloses that some affiliate links can generate commission. The shown referral screen lists percentage tiers but zero partners; it does not demonstrate anyone receiving downline income. There is a deposit option elsewhere, yet the described miner activation uses an on-screen control. The evidence therefore does not establish that paying or recruiting is required to start the demonstrated mining feature.

citations.quote: a link which you can copy and share with your friends and family so they can all sign up
Some of the links in videos on this channel are affiliate links, meaning that some of the purchases made through the links will give us a commission
so you just toggle your bar to your 100 percent to activate your miner instantly

rebuttal.rebuttal: A referral program and an affiliate disclosure show incentives, but neither establishes that the audience must recruit anyone to access the miner. The cited daily-profit claim concerns an optional deposit path, while the speaker describes activating the miner by moving a control. The opening does not show a required purchase of mining capacity or an actual referral payout.

citations.quote: so you just toggle your bar to your 100 percent to activate your miner instantly
they also have a deposit download here where you can deposit an end percentage by deposits per of your deposit

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not whether payment or recruitment is required to activate the free miner. The speaker separately invites viewers to send Litecoin to a provided address and claims a daily percentage of the deposit. The referral feature adds an incentive to bring others in, but the deposit-linked return is sufficient to distinguish this from an ordinary referral promotion.

We also have an affiliate program on this site where you can refer friends and families on this site and earn amazing income.
